description: This file defines the API endpoints for managing 'likes' on shared posts within the Buzz component of the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for listing likes, liking a share, and unliking a share, along with validation rules and Swagger documentation annotations.

classes.name: BuzzLikeOnShareAPI
classes.description: API class for managing likes on shared posts in the Buzz module, including listing, creating (liking), and deleting (unliking) shares.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of likes for a specific share/post, with support for sorting and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Allows a user to like a specific share/post.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Allows a user to unlike a previously liked share/post.

methods.name: setBuzzLikeOnShare
methods.description: Populates a BuzzLikeOnShare entity with share ID and employee number, and sets the liked timestamp.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the GET all likes endpoint.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for liking a share.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for unliking a share.
